National Assembly
Complete Verbatim Report of the Meeting
Volume 23
Wednesday, Ashad 23, 2083
Meeting Number - 29 (Second)

The second meeting of the National Assembly today commenced at 17:46 hrs under the chairmanship of the Right Honourable Chairperson, Mr. Narayan Prasad Dahal.

Right Honourable Chairperson: Honourable Members, the second meeting of the National Assembly today (17:46 hrs) begins. Honourable Members, I now provide time to the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, on behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister, Mr. Balendra Shah, to present the proposal to send the "Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion.

Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Ms. Sobita Gautam: (17:46 hrs) Honourable Chairperson, with the permission of the Chairperson, I present before this esteemed assembly the proposal to send the "Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. Thank you.

Right Honourable Chairperson: Honourable Members, I now present for decision the proposal to send the "Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. (17:47 hrs) Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye" and Honourable Members against it will say "No".

Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye".
- "Aye"
Honourable Members against this proposal will say "No".

No "No" voices were heard. Therefore, I declare that the proposal to send the "Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion has been unanimously approved.

Honourable Members, I now provide time to the Honourable Minister for Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, to present the proposal to send the "Anti-Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion.

Honourable Minister for Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle: (17:48 hrs) Honourable Chairperson, with the permission of the Chairperson, I present before this esteemed assembly the proposal to send the "Anti-Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. Thank you.

Right Honourable Chairperson: Honourable Members, I now present for decision the proposal to send the "Anti-Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. (17:48 hrs) Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye" and Honourable Members against it will say "No".

Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye".
- "Aye"
Honourable Members against this proposal will say "No".

No "No" voices were heard. Therefore, I declare that the proposal to send the "Anti-Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion has been unanimously approved.

Honourable Members, I now provide time to the Honourable Minister for Land Management, Cooperatives and Poverty Alleviation, Ms. Pratibha Rawal, to present the proposal to send the "Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion.

Honourable Minister for Land Management, Cooperatives and Poverty Alleviation, Ms. Pratibha Rawal: (17:50 hrs) Honourable Chairperson, with the permission of the Chairperson, I present before this esteemed assembly the proposal to send the "Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. Thank you.

Right Honourable Chairperson: Honourable Members, I now present for decision the proposal to send the "Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. (17:50 hrs) Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye" and Honourable Members against it will say "No".

Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye".
- "Aye"
Honourable Members against this proposal will say "No".

No "No" voices were heard. Therefore, I declare that the proposal to send the "Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion has been unanimously approved.

Honourable Members, I now provide time to the Honourable Minister for Health and Population, Ms. Nisha Mehta, to present the proposal to send the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institutes, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion.

Honourable Minister for Health and Population, Ms. Nisha Mehta: (17:51 hrs) Honourable Chairperson, with the permission of the Chairperson, I present before this esteemed assembly the proposal to send the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institutes, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. Thank you.

Right Honourable Chairperson: Honourable Members, I now present for decision the proposal to send the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institutes, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion. (17:52 hrs) Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye" and Honourable Members against it will say "No".

Honourable Members in favour of this proposal will say "Aye".
- "Aye"
Honourable Members against this proposal will say "No".

No "No" voices were heard. Therefore, I declare that the proposal to send the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institutes, 2083", received with a message from the House of Representatives, to the Legislation Management Committee for clause-wise discussion has been unanimously approved.

Honourable Members, the next meeting of the National Assembly will be held on Thursday, Ashad 24, 2083, at 12:15 PM. This meeting is hereby adjourned.

(Subsequently, the meeting was adjourned to be held on Thursday, Ashad 25, 2083, at 12:15 PM.)

Adjourned: 17:53 hrs.

sections.summary_en: The second meeting of the National Assembly commenced under the chairmanship of Honourable Chairperson Narayan Prasad Dahal. The Chairperson then allocated time for ministers to present proposals.

speakers.name: Narayan Prasad Dahal
speakers.topic: Opening the meeting and allocating time

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: Three bills were presented by their respective ministers and unanimously approved for clause-wise discussion in the Legislation Management Committee. These included the Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, the Anti-Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Bill, and the Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, all received with messages from the House of Representatives.
